hook.text: An audit declares the site accessible. Six months later, new features have introduced 40 new violations.

buildup.text: Accessibility is not a one-time achievement. New content and features can introduce new barriers constantly.

discovery.text: Continuous monitoring tools scan pages regularly and alert teams to new violations as they appear.

twist.text: Monitoring dashboards track trends over time. A rising violation count signals a process problem, not just bugs.

climax.text: Monthly scans show violations trending downward. The team's culture of accessibility is measurably working.

punchline.text: Monitor continuously. Accessibility degrades without ongoing attention.

quiz.question: Why is continuous accessibility monitoring needed?
options: New features constantly introduce new accessibility barriers
